lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 2 — The Holy Spirit Comes at Pentecost

questions.questionText: On what special day were the believers all together in one place?
What sound suddenly came from heaven?
options: A sound like a violent wind

questions.questionText: Where did the sound of the wind fill?
options: The whole house where they were sitting

questions.questionText: What did they see that looked like tongues of fire?
options: What seemed to be tongues of fire on each of them

questions.questionText: What happened after the tongues of fire rested on them?
options: They were filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke in other tongues

questions.questionText: Who enabled them to speak in other tongues?
Where were God-fearing Jews from every nation staying?
Why did a crowd come together in bewilderment?
options: Because each one heard their own language being spoken

questions.questionText: Who asked, “Aren’t all these who are speaking Galileans?”
The crowd asked, “How is it that each of us hears them in our _____ language?”
Which of these groups was listed among the visitors who heard their own language?
Visitors from which famous city are named in the crowd?
What did the visitors hear the believers declaring?
Who asked one another, “What does this mean?”
Some people made fun of them and said what?
Who stood up with the Eleven and raised his voice to the crowd?
What time of day did Peter say it was when he said they were not drunk?
Peter said this day was what I spoke about long ago. I am a prophet. Who am I?
Joel said God would pour out his Spirit on _____ people.
According to Joel, who would prophesy?
Joel said, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be _____. ”
Peter said I was a man from Nazareth, accredited by God with miracles, wonders and signs. Who am I?
What did the people do to Jesus, with the help of wicked men?
options: They crowned him king in Rome
They put him to death by nailing him to the cross

questions.questionText: Who raised Jesus from the dead?
Who said about the Messiah, “You will not let your holy one see decay”?
True or false: Peter said David died, was buried, and his tomb was still there.
options: False — David’s tomb was in Rome
False — David went to heaven without dying

questions.questionText: What had God promised David on oath?
options: That he would place one of David’s descendants on his throne
That the temple would never fall

questions.questionText: When David spoke of the holy one not seeing decay, who was he talking about?
Who did Peter say are all witnesses that God raised Jesus to life?
options: Peter and the other believers speaking

questions.questionText: From where has Jesus poured out what the crowd now sees and hears?
options: Exalted to the right hand of God, he received the Spirit from the Father
From the Mount of Olives only

questions.questionText: True or false: Peter said David himself ascended to heaven.
options: False — David did not ascend to heaven
False — David is still alive on earth
True — David flew up in a cloud that day

questions.questionText: Peter said God has made this Jesus, whom they crucified, both _____ and Messiah.
How did the people feel when they heard Peter’s words?
options: They were cut to the heart

questions.questionText: Who said to Peter and the other apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”
Who said, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ”?
What gift did Peter say they would receive after they repent and are baptized?
options: The gift of the Holy Spirit

questions.questionText: Who did Peter say the promise is for?
options: You and your children and all who are far off

questions.questionText: Who pleaded, “Save yourselves from this corrupt generation”?
About how many people accepted the message and were baptized that day?
What four things did the new believers devote themselves to?
options: Sports, shopping, sleep, and songs only
The apostles’ teaching, fellowship, breaking of bread, and prayer

questions.questionText: Who performed many wonders and signs that filled everyone with awe?
True or false: All the believers were together and had everything in common.
options: False — they hid from each other
False — they lived in different cities only

questions.questionText: What did they do with property and possessions?
options: They sold them to give to anyone who had need

questions.questionText: Where did they meet together every day?
Where did they break bread and eat together?
options: On the Mount of Olives only

questions.questionText: How did they eat together?
Who added to their number daily those who were being saved?
What two things does verse 47 say they were doing while the Lord added people?
options: Praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people

questions.questionText: I stood up at nine in the morning and told the crowd they were not drunk. Who am I?
How many apostles stood with Peter when he first spoke to the crowd?
